blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan – The Student Supreme Council of PHINMA University of Pangasinan (UPang) has backed strong opposition to the United States-led Pax Silica initiative and its proposed hub in New Clark City, Capas, Tarlac, citing concerns over national sovereignty, environmental protection, and the rights of Indigenous communities. In a statement, the student council said it rejects what it described as a development model that prioritizes foreign strategic and corporate interests over Filipino rights and welfare.
